# AuthPlugin by ElMarcels

![Paper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54007756111b2549ed71ed1b5f81bece10a83e7d_0.webp)
![Spigot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3de00af069f8caf2d3b3ce0901f3f7f6400d326_0.webp)
![Bukkit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d862c7ec0722b2acfc9b184e3150eab08c0163b5_0.webp)

You can support the plugin donating in https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/ElMarcels

## ⁉️ About the plugin
  - This plugin is a very complete authentication plugin that contains a very secure registration and login system. Currently, the initial version does not have a /premium option, but the premium system will be added in a future update. 

## 📌 COMMANDS
  - The /login command doesn't works!! You have to use the /l (password) command.
  - The /register command doesn't works!! You have to use the /reg (password) (password) command.
  - Use /authreload to reload the plugin config.

## 🖥️ CONFIG
  - You can change the default spanish messages and the plugin prefix at the bottom of the file config.yml which you will find in the plugin folder created within the **"plugins"** folder of your server.

## 🐛 How to Report Issues
  - You can report issues by sending an email to marcels@jixen.xyz or contact.elmarcelsdev@gmail.com
